subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode support a default-off full completed-draft/checklist preservation mode beyond the current one-line collapse summary?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses progress drafts to a compact summary, and accepting the request would add a new public config/lifecycle contract plus checklist presentation semantics.

options.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned option that keeps the full completed progress draft/checklist visible while preserving current collapse behavior as the default.

options.title: Keep the one-line summary
options.body: Treat the current collapse-summary behavior as the intended Telegram finalization policy and decline full completed-draft preservation for now.

options.title: Design structured progress cards first
options.body: Defer the Telegram-specific knob until a cross-channel structured progress-card API defines checklist state and finalization consistently.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned option that keeps the full completed progress draft/checklist visible while preserving current collapse behavior as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the current Telegram collapse-summary implementation and tests that this product decision would alter.
